def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n <= 11:
        points = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(5):
                points[i][j] = int(next(it))

        vectors = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for __ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(5):
                    vectors[i][j][k] = points[j][k] - points[i][k]

        bad = set()
        for i in range(n):
            flag = False
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    if not equal(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) and dot(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]):
                        bad.add(i+1)
                        flag = True
                        break
                if flag:
                    break

        good_count = n - len(bad)
        print(good_count)
        for i in range(1, n+1):
            if i not in bad:
                print(i)
    else:
        print(0)

def equal(a, b):
    return all(x == y for x, y in zip(a, b))

def dot(a, b):
    res = 0
    for i in range(5):
        res += a[i] * b[i]
    return res > 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
